verdict.rationale: Datalab documents pipelines as chains of processors in versioned, reusable configurations that can be deployed to production. Published agent processors can be pinned to a specific version (`<id>@<version>`), which implies you could roll back by pinning an earlier version. There is no evidence of a review or diff workflow, no explicit rollback feature, and no detail on how versioning works. Missing for 10: a documented review/diff or approval workflow, explicit rollback or version-history management docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
